description: Where an entity binds. Mandatory per OD-01. Different site classes are never pooled into a single prevalence denominator: a small-molecule 7TM pocket and a receptor-peptide interface are not the same analysis object.
aggregation_rule: binding_site_class is a partitioning key for every later aggregate. Records whose class is unresolved are excluded from aggregates rather than defaulted into one.

binding_site_classes.definition: The classical orthosteric pocket within the seven-transmembrane bundle.
binding_site_classes.inclusion_rule: Small-molecule or small-peptide orthosteric ligand at a receptor whose family binds within the bundle.
binding_site_classes.exclusion_rule: Not used for polymer ligands binding predominantly above the bundle.
binding_site_classes.decision_logic: Assigned from entity form plus source binding-mode annotation. In Phase 2 it is provisional wherever geometry would be required to confirm it.

binding_site_classes.definition: An orthosteric site extending into the extracellular vestibule.
binding_site_classes.inclusion_rule: Source statement of an extended or vestibule-spanning pose.

binding_site_classes.definition: A receptor–peptide or receptor–protein interface, typically involving the N terminus and extracellular loops.
binding_site_classes.inclusion_rule: Polymer ligand, i.e. entity_form polymer_chain or polymer_segment with a pharmacological role.
binding_site_classes.decision_logic: This is the class that must never be pooled with canonical_7tm_pocket. It is the default site class for protein ligands.

binding_site_classes.definition: A site on the intracellular face, typically overlapping the transducer interface.
binding_site_classes.inclusion_rule: Source statement of intracellular allosteric binding.

binding_site_classes.definition: An allosteric site on the extracellular face outside the orthosteric pocket.
binding_site_classes.inclusion_rule: Source statement of extracellular allosteric binding.

binding_site_classes.definition: A site on the lipid-exposed outer surface of the bundle.
binding_site_classes.inclusion_rule: Source statement of a lipid-facing or membrane-embedded allosteric site.
binding_site_classes.exclusion_rule: Not assigned merely because the entity is a lipid; environment lipids receive no site class.

binding_site_classes.definition: The site of a covalently bonded ligand within the bundle, as for opsin retinal.
binding_site_classes.inclusion_rule: Covalent linkage to a receptor residue plus a pharmacological role.

binding_site_classes.definition: The site engaged by a tethered receptor-segment ligand.
binding_site_classes.inclusion_rule: entity_form receptor_segment with a sourced range.

binding_site_classes.definition: A single entity engaging more than one region.
binding_site_classes.inclusion_rule: Source statement of bitopic or multi-region binding.

binding_site_classes.definition: A characterised site outside the listed classes.
binding_site_classes.inclusion_rule: Source describes a site that does not match any class above.

binding_site_classes.definition: The site class could not be determined.
binding_site_classes.inclusion_rule: Default for any pharmacological ligand whose site is not stated by a source and cannot be assigned from entity form.
binding_site_classes.decision_logic: Excluded from aggregates; queued for manual review. Guessing a site class would corrupt every later prevalence figure.

vocabulary_status.policy: A value outside this file may not appear in any Phase 2 artefact. The test suite fails on an unknown value. Adding a value requires an entry in governance/DECISION_LOG.md.
